description: Paste SVG code or upload an .svg file and rasterize it to PNG at any size.

faqs.a: Your SVG is drawn to a canvas at your chosen width and height, then exported as a PNG.
Type or paste code into the box, or upload an .svg file — both work.
faqs.q: Can I paste code or upload a file?

faqs.a: Set any width and height; the SVG scales crisply since it is vector.
faqs.q: What output size can I get?

howto: Paste SVG code or upload an .svg file.
Set the output width and height.
Click Download PNG to save it.
title: SVG to PNG Converter
